body:
I noticed a list on my desk labeled "Volunteers Needed for Community Services." My fingers twitched as I flipped through it, but no name was mine. Panic surged inside me. If this isn't just an oversight, I can't stand for it.

My mind raced back to when we had volunteered together at the school fair. The last time, our efforts were acknowledged publicly in the newspaper. Could this be a repeat? 

I took a deep breath before getting up from my chair, my chest tightening with anger.
full:
I noticed a list on my desk labeled "Volunteers Needed for Community Services." My fingers twitched as I flipped through it, but no name was mine. Panic surged inside me. If this isn't just an oversight, I can't stand for it.

My mind raced back to when we had volunteered together at the school fair. The last time, our efforts were acknowledged publicly in the newspaper. Could this be a repeat? 

I took a deep breath before getting up from my chair, my chest tightening with anger. Next: confront the person responsible directly.
